item.title: Jack Hughes scores in overtime as US beats Canada for gold at the Olympics
item.description: No miracle needed. The United States is on top of the hockey world for the first time in nearly a half-century.

item.title: Department of Homeland Security suspends Global Entry as the partial government shutdown drags on
item.description: DALLAS (AP) — The Department of Homeland Security said Sunday that the Global Entry program would be shut down as long as the partial government shutdown remains in effect. item.title: You could be seeing an increase in your next BBQ brisket plate
item.description: As we previously reported, Texas Pitmasters warn that the state’s barbecue industry is under growing pressure. Pitmasters state that droughts, thinning herds, and supply delays are driving up beef prices and forcing some smokehouses out of business.

item.title: Panhandle Breast Health awarded $30,000 to fund free breast cancer screenings
item.description: Officials with Panhandle Breast Health are set to receive a $30,000 award from AstraZeneca to fund free breast cancer screenings for more than 100 uninsured residents.

item.title: Clerical error tied to Tyson exemption leaves Potter County facing $412K revenue shortfall
item.description: A clerical error involving a tax exemption for Tyson Foods has left Potter County facing a projected $412,000 deficit in the county’s budget, prompting county leaders to reassess their budget and prepare for possible financial adjustments next year.

item.title: '8 Ball' Fire in Armstrong County near Highway 287 estimated 13,500 acres; 100% contained
item.description: The Friends of the Armstrong County Fire Departments issued an advisory that crews were responding to a reported grass fire near Highway 287 and County Road 29 on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: 'Lavender' Fire in Oldham, Potter counties 18,423 acres burned; 100% contained
item.description: Fire crews are working a fire that started in Oldham County and is burning into Potter County.

item.title: Fire warning issued Tuesday after wildfire reported in Beaver County
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a fire warning at around 11:50 a.m. on Tuesday on request by the Oklahoma Forestry Service, after reports of a wildfire three miles northeast of Beaver in Beaver County.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
